description: This file defines interfaces for a worker thread and its factory within the Rialto server component, including methods for thread control and task queuing.

classes.name: IWorkerThread
classes.description: Interface for a worker thread that can be stopped, joined, and can enqueue tasks.

classes.name: IWorkerThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating instances of IWorkerThread.

methods.name: createWorkerThread
methods.description: Creates a new worker thread instance.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Enqueues a task into the worker thread's task queue.
